Sempaevum 3D Shape Proof — Tin Can (R=1, h=3)

Every 3D shape decomposes into spherical harmonics c_l. Each ratio c_l/c_00 is a dimensionless seed that projects losslessly onto the lattice: Π₁₂(r) = (k, d, ε). The tower is infinite — infinite harmonics — exact reconstruction. Toggle the surfaces below to see convergence. Grey wireframe = exact shape. Colors = Sempaevum reconstruction.
Click legend entries to toggle surfaces. The green (l=160) reconstruction is nearly indistinguishable from the exact shape. The red (l=10) shows the Gibbs-like overshoot at edges that disappears with more harmonics. Every harmonic has a lattice address — none are lost.
